# pve_node_hosts (Data Source)

Reads the `/etc/hosts` file of one node (`GET /nodes/{node}/hosts`) as ordered entries. Blank lines and `#` comments are skipped.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright IBM Corp. 2021, 2026
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

data "pve_node_hosts" "pve1" {
  node = "pve1"
}

output "pve1_hosts_entries" {
  value = data.pve_node_hosts.pve1.entries
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) The cluster node name whose `/etc/hosts` is read.

### Read-Only

- `digest` (String) Digest of the current file as reported by the node.
- `entries` (Attributes List) Ordered entries of the hosts file. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entries))
- `id` (String) Identifier of the data source; equals `node`.

<a id="nestedatt--entries"></a>
### Nested Schema for `entries`

Read-Only:

- `address` (String) IP address of the entry.
- `hostnames` (List of String) Hostnames of the entry; the first is the canonical name.
